tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification Policy

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, including development builds, with no build-type exception. This is paired with the recorded decision to use HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so internal hosts are not served over plain HTTP either.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

The two recorded decisions behind it are "verification on all builds" (#22) and "https everywhere, no exceptions" (#25). I left out the retired dev-build exception and the plain-HTTP-for-internal-hosts note.
